title: Coinbase Says Its AI Blocked $4.7 Million in Deepfake Elon Musk Scam
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Coinbase Says Its AI Blocked $4.7 Million in Deepfake Elon Musk Scam Coinbase said its AI scam-prevention agent stopped about $4.7 million, roughly 91% of what customers tried to send, from reaching scammers running a deepfake Elon Musk crypto giveaway. This post Coinbase Says Its AI Blocked $4.7 Million in Deepfake Elon Musk Scam first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
